name: Transaction Type And Additional Parameters 23
definition: Specifies the conditions under which the order/trade is to be settled.

AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Owner Transaction Identification
AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction (unique per piece of collateral) as known by the account owner (or the instructing party managing the account).

AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Servicer Transaction Identification
AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction (unique per piece of collateral) as known by the account servicer.

SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType.name: Securities Financing Transaction Type
SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType.definition: Specifies the type of securities financing transaction, that is, repurchase agreement, reverse repurchase agreement, securities lending or securities borrowing.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies how the transaction is to be settled, for example, against payment.

ModificationType.name: Modification Type
ModificationType.definition: Identifies the type of securities financing modification requested.

CommonIdentification.name: Common Identification
CommonIdentification.definition: Unique reference agreed upon by the two trade counterparties to identify the trade.

PoolIdentification.name: Pool Identification
PoolIdentification.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

NonceIdentification.name: Nonce Identification
NonceIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of a random or semi-random number used once (NONCE) generated in the frame of a cryptographic communication.
